svg.title: Figure 3-2. System FMEA failure chains — sheet 2 of 7 (SFM)
svg.desc: System FMEA failure chains, sheet 2 of 7 (SFM rev 0.23): failure modes SFM-005 to SFM-009 (5 failure modes, 15 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.
svg.text: Figure 3-2 · System FMEA failure chains — sheet 2 of 7
SFM rev 0.23 · BL-005 · draft · SFM-005 … SFM-009 · 15 causes on this sheet
FAILURE CAUSE · O · D · AP · ACTIONS (STEPS 4–6)
F1 Lateral control: request steering torque
from the EPS to keep the vehicle in its lane
Loss of lateral control without driver alert
End effect: Driver unaware of loss; lane departure
EPS stops accepting requests without a fault signal on CAN
pandad stops forwarding TX without the state being reported
Process crash or hang not detected by liveness checks
Lateral command frozen at last value
End effect: Vehicle leaves the lane on a curve or straight
controlsd hangs while card keeps sending the last carControl
modeld output frozen (stale frame) but still published as valid
Messaging delivers stale data with fresh timestamps
End effect: Driver discomfort; possible over-correction by driver
Controller instability (gain, delay compensation, lagd estimate)
Control loop timing jitter (CPU load, thermal throttling)
End effect: Rear-end collision with lead vehicle or loss of control
Planner targets higher speed (missed lead, wrong set speed)
Wrong scaling of acceleration request for this car
Powertrain applies more acceleration than requested
End effect: Rear-end collision by following vehicle; occupant
False lead (radar ghost, model false positive) or FCW false trigger

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
